title: Risk landscape overview
description: Provide a high-level summary of the current risk landscape.
query: What does the overall risk landscape look like? Summarise the key threat actors, risk types, and impacted assets.

title: APT-28 campaign analysis
description: Analyse the activities of the APT-28 threat group across all events.
query: What has APT-28 been doing? Describe their campaign including targets, techniques, and timeline.

title: Third-party and contractor risk
description: Assess risks introduced by third-party contractors and vendors.
query: What risks have third-party contractors and vendors introduced, and which assets have they put at risk?

title: Cloud infrastructure exposure
description: Analyse the risk exposure of cloud infrastructure assets.
query: How exposed is our cloud infrastructure? What events have targeted it and through what risk mechanisms?

title: Risk score distribution analysis
description: Analyse the distribution of risk scores and identify the most severe risk categories.
query: How are risk scores distributed across different risk types? Which categories are the most severe and why?

title: Events impacting multiple assets
description: Identify events that impact more than one asset, indicating broader organisational exposure.
query: Which risk events impacted multiple assets simultaneously, and what does that tell us about systemic vulnerabilities?

title: Incident response overview
description: Summarise the state of all incident response processes and their progress.
query: What is the current state of our incident response efforts? How many processes are open, in progress, or resolved, and what work remains?

title: Accountability and ownership gaps
description: Identify events or process steps that lack clear ownership or accountability.
query: Are there any gaps in accountability across our risk mitigation processes? Which severe events lack a response, and which response steps are incomplete?
